cohort: 105 V3 freeze, 15 HC and 25 ON/OFF patient pairs
fallback_rule: Read the archived prospective calibration gate. If none passes, favor the lower worst S5 Wilson upper limit, then higher blinded disjoint-training label ARI. Use the archived method, with the original penalty and windows. Do not use real group P values.
full_refit_reference: V4 Reliability A3 point-estimate fold 0 G1 template; original within-fold participant strata and paired multiplicities
transition: Probability conditional on source state at an adjacent valid TR, including self transitions. Only 12 directed off-diagonal entries enter hypothesis tests.
coverage_gate: Two participant-level multivariate ILR permutation tests, Holm across OFF-HC and ON-HC. A corrected whole-composition result is required for corresponding HC contrast Coverage localization.
exploratory_family: GEV, Spatial Dispersion, switching rate, label-invariant ILR sensitivity, and all same-direction conjunctions; also report a full joint correction across all scalar contrast rows. Pool eligible exploratory tests across statistics for an additional model-union correction.
scope: Exploratory reanalysis of an already inspected cohort. The archived high-noise gate was not met. No WEiDA features are read or generated.
